## Data and coefficients

```{r data}
load(here("data/_processed/wca-partitions.RData"))   # wca_train, wca_val

read_coefs <- function(path) {
  list(species = read_excel(path, sheet = "species"),
       population = read_excel(path, sheet = "population"))
}
```

---

## Figure 2: population vs. species allometric curves

```{r figure2-data}
ht_coefs    <- read_coefs(here("rslt/dbh-ht/dbh-ht-coefs.xlsx"))
canopy_coefs <- read_coefs(here("rslt/dbh-canopy/dbh-canopy-coefs.xlsx"))
agedbh_coefs <- read_coefs(here("rslt/age-dbh/dbh-age-coefs.xlsx"))
ageht_coefs  <- read_coefs(here("rslt/age-ht/age-ht-coefs.xlsx"))

pop_color <- "#2E8B57"
spp_color <- "grey70"
```

```{r figure2-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
allometry_panel <- function(coefs, data, xvar, xlab, ylab) {
  b0 <- coefs$population$estimate[coefs$population$term == "intercept"]
  b1 <- coefs$population$estimate[coefs$population$term == "slope"]

  x <- data[[xvar]]
  x_grid <- exp(seq(log(min(x, na.rm = TRUE)), log(max(x, na.rm = TRUE)), length.out = 100))
  pop_line <- tibble(x = x_grid, y = exp(b0 + b1 * log(x_grid)), curve = "Population")

  rng <- data |>
    group_by(spp) |>
    summarise(xmin = min(.data[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE),
              xmax = max(.data[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  sp_lines <- coefs$species |>
    inner_join(rng, by = "spp") |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(x = list(exp(seq(log(xmin), log(xmax), length.out = 50)))) |>
    unnest(x) |>
    mutate(y = exp(intercept + slope * log(x)), curve = "Species") |>
    ungroup()

  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, color = curve)) +
    geom_line(data = sp_lines, aes(group = spp), alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(data = pop_line, linewidth = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Population = pop_color, Species = spp_color), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

ht_data     <- wca_train |> filter(dbh_height_is_anom == FALSE)
canopy_data <- wca_train |> filter(dbh_height_canopy_width_is_anom == FALSE) |> drop_na(canopy_width_avg_m)
age_data    <- wca_train |> filter(age_dbh_height_is_anom == FALSE, !is.na(age))

figure2 <- (
  allometry_panel(ht_coefs, ht_data, "dbh", "DBH (cm)", "Height (m)") +
  allometry_panel(canopy_coefs, canopy_data |> rename(canopy = canopy_width_avg_m), "dbh", "DBH (cm)", "Canopy width (m)") +
  allometry_panel(agedbh_coefs, age_data, "age", "Age (years)", "DBH (cm)") +
  allometry_panel(ageht_coefs, age_data |> filter(!is.na(height)), "age", "Age (years)", "Height (m)")
) + plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

figure2

fs::dir_create(here("_img/manuscript-figures"))
ggsave(here("_img/manuscript-figures/figure2_species_allometry.png"), figure2, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Figure 3: species deviations from the height-DBH population curve

```{r figure3, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=5.5}
b0 <- ht_coefs$population$estimate[ht_coefs$population$term == "intercept"]
b1 <- ht_coefs$population$estimate[ht_coefs$population$term == "slope"]

dbh_small <- quantile(ht_data$dbh, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
dbh_large <- quantile(ht_data$dbh, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

s_dev <- ht_coefs$species |>
  transmute(
    spp,
    d_small = (intercept + slope * log(dbh_small)) - (b0 + b1 * log(dbh_small)),
    d_large = (intercept + slope * log(dbh_large)) - (b0 + b1 * log(dbh_large))
  ) |>
  mutate(
    score = sqrt(d_small^2 + d_large^2),
    label = if_else(rank(-score) <= 3, spp, NA_character_),
    point_col = if_else(rank(-score) <= 3, pop_color, spp_color)
  )

figure3 <- ggplot(s_dev, aes(x = d_small, y = d_large)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(color = point_col), size = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), na.rm = TRUE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = pop_color) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  labs(x = paste0("log-height deviation at DBH ", round(dbh_small, 1)),
       y = paste0("log-height deviation at DBH ", round(dbh_large, 1)))

figure3

ggsave(here("_img/manuscript-figures/figure3_species_deviations.png"), figure3, width = 5.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Figure S3: mixed-model vs. species-model RMSPE validation

Source: `scripts/r/dbh-ht-model.R`, RMSPE comparison section.

```{r s3-summary}
rmspe_df <- read_csv(here("rslt/dbh-ht/dbh-ht-rmspe-comparison.csv"))

s3_summary <- tibble(
  quantity = c("mean RMSPE - mixed model", "mean RMSPE - species model",
               "% agreeing within 5% (rel. to smaller)", "% agreeing within 5% (rel. to mixed model)"),
  value = c(
    mean(rmspe_df$lmer_rmspe),
    mean(rmspe_df$mcpherson_rmspe),
    mean(abs(rmspe_df$lmer_rmspe - rmspe_df$mcpherson_rmspe) / pmin(rmspe_df$lmer_rmspe, rmspe_df$mcpherson_rmspe) <= 0.05) * 100,
    mean(abs(rmspe_df$lmer_rmspe - rmspe_df$mcpherson_rmspe) / rmspe_df$lmer_rmspe <= 0.05) * 100
  )
)
knitr::kable(s3_summary, digits = 2)
```

Means match draft text (2.28 / 2.31). Neither 5% threshold above reproduces
the draft's claimed 88%. Plot below uses `lmer`/`mcpherson` (squared error),
not their square root, despite the axis/caption saying RMSPE.

```{r s3-plot, fig.width=3.2, fig.height=3.2}
top_n <- 2
plot_df <- rmspe_df |>
  mutate(label = if_else(rank(-diff) <= top_n, spp, NA_character_),
         highlight = if_else(!is.na(label), "highlight", "background"))

figureS3 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = lmer, y = mcpherson)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, highlight == "background"),
             color = "grey50", alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, highlight == "highlight"),
             color = "#2E8B57", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), na.rm = TRUE, size = 3,
                            hjust = 1, direction = "y", nudge_x = -0.05) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Mixed Model RMSPE", y = "Species Model RMSPE")

figureS3

ggsave(here("_img/manuscript-figures/figureS3_rmspe_validation.png"), figureS3, width = 3, height = 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
